claims.statement: A successful preregistered row-dependent exponential detector with temperatures at most tau_A implies the frozen INT-AOD detector and excludes zero rows.
Ordinary cumulants of the occupancy equal the sum of joint cumulants over all ordered candidate-offset tuples, including repetitions.
Deterministic terminal-prime strata and preregistered lower scales can be fixed without observing output-prime incidence.
Each registered stratum has first cumulant at least cX.
The ordered joint-cumulant sum decomposes exactly by equality partitions of column indices.
The renormalized local connected singular-series kernel has a subcritical tree radius.
Selected primorial-walk residue correlations satisfy the explicit orthogonality estimate required by the connected kernel.
For every stratum, |c_k| <= c_1 k! D^(k-1) with D << X/(log X)^(1+delta).
A row-uniform Hardy--Littlewood factorial-moment theorem through logarithmic order with the registered error budget implies INT-AOD.
